description: This file defines the MediaListBuilder class for listing media items in Drupal, including methods for building headers and rows, and managing media entity queries.

classes.name: MediaListBuilder
classes.description: A class that provides a listing interface for media entities in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MediaListBuilder with services and checks for thumbnail style existence.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MediaListBuilder using dependency injection container.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the media list table, including optional thumbnail and language columns.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a data row for each media entity, including thumbnail, name, type, author, status, update time, and language.

methods.name: getEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves entity IDs for media items, sorted by last changed time, with optional pagination.
